answer: Because the opal cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the bridge ledger, the vertex audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 8 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The fee repeats 25 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
